about.description: Fresh Eats. Fresh Treats. Counter Culture is home to The Humphrey and offers fresh sandwiches, salads, and yogurt treats.

menu.name: Avocado Delight
menu.description: Lightly seasoned, fresh sliced avocado served on wheat bread and dressed with mayonnaise, sprouts, tomato, lettuce, cheddar cheese and seasoning.

menu.name: Chopped Chicken
menu.description: Fresh cooked boneless chicken breast diced and lightly seasoned served on wheat bread with tomato, lettuce, sprouts and mayonnaise.

menu.name: Smoked Turkey
menu.description: Heaping portions of thin sliced, smoked turkey on wheat bread with tomato, lettuce, sprouts, seasoning and mayonnaise.

menu.name: Chicken Salad
menu.description: Jan's famous homemade recipe made country fresh each day with toasted almonds and a touch of pineapple. Garnished with seasoning, tomato, lettuce and sprouts on wheat bread.

menu.name: Tuna Salad
menu.description: Delicious homemade tuna salad garnished with seasoning, tomato, lettuce and sprouts on wheat bread.

menu.name: Pimento Cheese
menu.description: Our own pimento cheese garnished with seasoning, tomato, lettuce and sprouts on wheat bread.

menu.name: Egg Salad
menu.description: Specially prepared combination on wheat bread garnished with seasoning, tomato, lettuce and sprouts.

menu.name: Peanut Butter & Jelly Sandwich
menu.description: Three-layers of wheat bread with grape jelly and creamy peanut butter.

menu.name: Steak & Cheese
menu.description: Hot and hefty portion of thinly sliced choice beef on a poboy style bun with cheddar cheese, seasoning, mustard and special dressing.

menu.name: Ham & Cheese
menu.description: Piping hot hickory smoked ham on a poboy style bun with cheddar cheese, seasoning, mustard and special dressing.

menu.name: Muffuletta
menu.description: Salami, ham, olive mix and provolone cheese on Gambino bread.

menu.name: Pizzaletta Slice
menu.description: A Muffuletta sandwiched between two pizza crusts.

menu.name: Hot Tuna Melt
menu.description: Our homemade tuna salad dressed with seasoning, lettuce, tomato, avocado, chipotle mayo and your choice of cheese on a specialty sourdough bread.

menu.name: Hot Meat Melt
menu.description: Your choice of turkey, ham, chicken or steak dressed with seasoning, lettuce, tomato, avocado, chipotle mayo and your choice of cheese on a specialty sourdough bread.

menu.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
menu.description: Three-layers of wheat bread with cheddar cheese.

menu.name: Side Salad
menu.description: Lettuce, cheddar cheese and diced tomatoes.

menu.name: The Combination Salad
menu.description: Delicious blend of garden-fresh, in-season vegetables topped with egg salad and sprouts. The dressing of your choice on the side.

menu.name: Chef Salad
menu.description: One of our appetizing combination salads garnished with your choice of tasty meats and cheddar.

specials.name: The Humphrey Yogurt
specials.description: Tangy plain frozen yogurt topped with fresh fruit, honey, and granola.
